title: The TW Hya Rosetta Stone Project. I. Radial and Vertical Distributions of DCN and DCO<SUP>+</SUP>
question: Which parts of the TW Hya disk host active deuterium fractionation chemistry, as traced by the radial, vertical and temperature distributions of DCO+ and DCN?

what.value: Line catalogue data (frequencies, Aij, Eu, partition functions)

evidence.quote: Line catalogue data from CDMS (cite: Muller05)

what.value: DCO+ molecular file for radiative transfer

evidence.quote: We used the DCO$^+$ molecular file from LAMDA (cite: Schoier05)

recipe.goal: Image line cubes and moment maps
recipe.method: Continuum subtraction, CLEAN with manual masks, Briggs 0.5; second set smoothed to 0.5'' circular beam; moment-0 from channels above 3σ
Azimuthal averaging of deprojected moment-0 maps in narrow rings
LTE rotational diagram with optical depth correction on fluxes within 100 au (0.5'' cubes); DCN 2–1 excluded
Power-law disk density and temperature structure; RADMC-3D radiative transfer, vis_sample, tclean; compare radial profiles by eye
key_parameters: Sigma(20au)=35 g cm-2, gamma=-1.3, H(20au)=2 au, p=0.3, mean molecular weight 2.37, T_atm=125 K at 10 au

evidence.quote: 2.6 and 3.9$\times10^{12}$ cm$^{-2}$, respectively for DCN and DCO$^+$
2.6 and 3.9$\times10^{12}$ cm$^{-2}$, respectively for DCN and DCO$^+$

answer_key.quantity: Disk-averaged excitation temperature DCO+ vs DCN

evidence.quote: DCO$^+$ appears colder than DCN (33 vs 66 K)
Between 25–70 au, the best-fit DCO$^+$ excitation temperatures are 37–39.5 K

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and uvcontsub fit order
Self-calibration details beyond solint, and whether 2016.1.00440.S data were self-calibrated
Radial bin widths for rotational diagrams, and MCMC priors and walker settings
Keplerian mask parameters, stellar mass and emission surface used
Source distance adopted for au conversions
Details of the 2017.1.00769.S data (not linked by archive)
Exact model grids, inner-hole depletion factor and molecular file for DCN
missing_for_reproduction: Exact clean/mask choices and channel selection
Model grids and DCN molecular file
score_reason: Public data and a reasonable but incompletely specified recipe; toy modelling is by eye.
rediscovery_reason: Public data and numeric rotational-diagram results can be redone, though settings are partly missing.
